matches.name: IsStrictlyPositive
matches.signature: def IsStrictlyPositive {A : Type*} [LE A] [Monoid A] [Zero A] (a : A) : Prop
matches.docstring:
An element of an ordered algebra is *strictly positive* if it is nonnegative and invertible.

NOTE: This definition will be generalized to the non-unital case in the future; do not unfold
the definition and use the API provided instead to avoid breakage when the refactor happens.

matches.name: ArithmeticFunction.LSeries_positive
matches.docstring:
If all values of a `ℂ`-valued arithmetic function `a` are nonnegative reals and `a 1` is
positive, then `L a x` is positive real for all real `x` larger than `abscissaOfAbsConv a`.

matches.name: ContinuousLinearMap.IsPositive
matches.docstring:
A continuous linear endomorphism `T` of a Hilbert space is **positive** if it is symmetric
and `∀ x, 0 ≤ re ⟪T x, x⟫`.
